sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
Thank you for your revised offer.
While we appreciate the step in our direction, the current proposal still does not reflect the realities of our production costs.
In the interest of our continued partnership, we can make a further concession to €51.50, but we will need a more substantial move from your side to reach an agreement.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We appreciate your continued steps towards our position, which we value in our long-standing partnership.
In response, we are prepared to make a further concession to €51.20 per unit under the same terms.
Please understand that we are now approaching the limits of what we can offer while maintaining the quality and reliability you expect from our foundry.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €51.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. We are now very close to the absolute limit of what we can offer while maintaining the quality and reliability you expect from our foundry. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

We value the long relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and trust that this proposal serves both our companies well.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Thank you for your continued movement towards our position. It has always been a privilege to work alongside Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, and we deeply value the long relationship our companies share. 

In response, we are prepared to make a further concession to €50.60 per unit under the same terms. Our offer comprises a price of €50.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please understand that we are now at the absolute limit of what we can offer while maintaining the quality you expect from our foundry. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Kindly note that our offer stays valid for 7 days. We hope to continue our shared journey together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
